name: palim
description: From thought to page. Illustrated EPUBs and unchanged ebook forwarding.

scripts.dev: npm run ui && npm run example && wrangler dev --local-protocol https
scripts.check:js: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/kindle.js && node --check pages/public/_worker.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:js && npm test
scripts.build: npm run ui && npm run example && npm run plugin && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run check && npm run ui && npm run example && npm run plugin && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:pages: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run check && node scripts/deploy-pages.mjs
